$doc: Campaign controller — the single spec sheet ops edits to retune the program. The engine and frontend both read this file. Env vars still hold the SECURITY gates (MEGAPOT_ACTIVE, MEGAPOT_WHITELIST, keys) — this file holds the PRODUCT parameters.

campaign.name: Megapot Rewards — Season 1
campaign.$note: network testnet = Base Sepolia accrual for internal testing; flip to mainnet after sign-off. start/end are hard bounds — fills outside the window never credit.

eligibility.$products: product suites this campaign covers: perps (native HL coins) | xyz-equities (coins prefixed xyz:) | baskets (fills recorded via thesis executions — needs app stitch) | predictions (not yet supported)
eligibility.$symbols: qualifying tickers — edit freely between runs; empty array = all symbols on the enabled products
eligibility.$excludeZeroFeePairs: symbols currently running zero-fee promos (no fee revenue → no credit), e.g. the xyz rebate campaign list

economics.$note: credit per fill = notional × feeBps × rolloverShare. Ticket conversion uses the LIVE on-chain ticketPrice() at buy time — never set a ticket price here.

levels.requires: Base rate: every qualifying trade counts once.
Trade on 5 distinct days in a week.
Hold 2x for 4 straight weeks, plus one basket run held to plan.
A full season streak plus a published rated thesis.

multipliers.$note: display + planned logic; engine applies 1.0x until the behavior signals are stitched from the app

firstTradeBonus.$note: new-user unlock: first qualifying trade grants baseTickets + floor(notional/plusPerUsd), capped at maxTickets. Converted to credit at the LIVE ticket price in buy().
